description: Everything the knowledge base holds about one passport attribute (official DIN definition, DE/EN explanation, synonyms, who typically has the data, unit, range, applicability per category, legal references, IDTA template elements) or one plausibility rule (message, fix hint, legal reference). Nothing is composed; unknown ids are an error.

id.description: A knowledge-base attribute id (e.g. "batteryChemistry") or a rule id (e.g. "PW-PLAUS-001")

lang.description: Language of the text summary (default en)

name: explain_attribute
title: Explain an attribute or rule
